# Client Hunter AI

> Lead generation platform for web developers. Find, score, and close local business leads with AI-powered outreach, heatmap search, and instant website audits.

Client Hunter AI helps freelance web developers and agencies discover local businesses that need new or improved websites. It scores leads automatically (no website = hot lead, weak site = needs upgrade) and generates personalized email, DM, and SMS outreach.
